methods.description: Identify present value, decimal rate and annual period count; express repeated multiplication as the correct power.
Evaluate PV times the whole growth factor, retaining unrounded calculator values.
Find future value and subtract the original amount.
Divide future value by the whole growth factor to find the initial investment.
Compare future value with the stated target and calculate excess or shortfall.
Divide the increase by the original amount, excluding the starting100 percent.
Try whole-number periods and check both the first successful year and its predecessor.
Calculate both future values and subtract unrounded values before final rounding.
